applies_why: The rule governs whether a HELD result may award DEFENDER WINS based on non-self-supported standing or a CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN collision.
quote: STATEMENT: RETRACTED: D2 vs C3 / CORRECTED RESULT: HELD-1
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: "A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count": one reading is that the retracted link-C3 reason cannot establish PROP-DEPENDENT standing; the other is that the later repeated CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN line still satisfies the rule despite the retraction.
why: The audit retracts the BROKEN grade and corrects the result to HELD-1, so the standing's stated reason does not count and no unretracted CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN collision supports DEFENDER WINS.
